headline: Votes on the Little Acorn Fund budget, the Code of Conduct update, and a warming shelter pick-up site.
summary: Residents will see October 2026 budget reports and incident reports. Votes are also set on the Little Acorn Fund budget, the Code of Conduct update, and a pick-up location for the No One Dies Warming Shelter.
items: Vote on Little Acorn Fund budget
Vote on update to Code of Conduct
Vote to become a pick-up location for No One Dies Warming Shelter
location: Woolley Conference Room, Pawtucket Public Library, 13 Summer Street, Pawtucket, Rhode Island 02860
